items.name: Luck Boost
items.description: Increases the odds of higher-rarity droids appearing on the Sandcrawler conveyor.

items.name: Crafting Boost
items.description: Boosts Droid Depot crafting speed and Pickaxe level for everyone in the session for 15 minutes.

items.name: Huyang Bundle
items.description: Permanently unlocks Huyang Hologram, in-base Kyber activation, Huyang Base Paint and the Kyber Droid Sell perk. Includes one Crafting Boost token.
details: Huyang Hologram Super Rebirth Perk: activate Kyber Droids inside your Base
Kyber Droid Sell Super Rebirth Perk

items.name: Companion Pack
items.description: A permanent bundle for companion-focused bases.

items.name: VIP Pack
items.description: A permanent VIP bundle with two Nova Shop perks.
details: VIP Status badge on your base
Daily Crystals from all Daily Quests

items.name: Starter Pack
items.description: A permanent starter bundle with credits, chips and a Nova Shop perk.

items.name: Crit Pack
items.description: A permanent bundle for Critical upgrades and effects.
details: Special Crit visual effect when you get a Critical hit

items.name: Rainbow Surge
items.description: Sends a wave of Rainbow Variant energy across the Sandcrawler conveyor every 30 seconds.
details: Each wave has a 10% chance to upgrade Blueprints it passes through to Rainbow.

items.name: Beskar Surge
items.description: Sends a wave of Beskar Variant energy across the Sandcrawler conveyor every 30 seconds.
details: Each wave has a 10% chance to upgrade Blueprints it passes through to Beskar.

items.name: Galactic Surge
items.description: Sends a wave of Galactic Variant energy across the Sandcrawler conveyor every 30 seconds.
details: Each wave has a 10% chance to upgrade Blueprints it passes through to Galactic.

items.name: Fusion Pack
items.description: Everything needed to get the Fusion room running.

items.name: Fusion Tank (2nd level)
items.description: The second Fusion Tank level, which is another Fusion Build slot.

items.name: Stellar Surge
items.description: Sends Stellar energy across the conveyor for 5 minutes.

items.name: Kyber Surge
items.description: Sends Kyber energy across the conveyor for 5 minutes.

items.name: Storage & Lounge Pack
items.description: Unlock the new Blueprint Storage appearance and add 6 levels each to Blueprint Storage and Lounge Slots.
details: Adds 6 Blueprint Storage levels, up to level 9
Adds 6 Lounge Slot levels, up to level 12
Marking this pack owned applies these levels once per profile. Reloading, importing or rechecking it will not add them again.
If your saved levels already include this pack, adjust them in Nova Shop after marking it owned.
The game refunds Nova Crystals for levels beyond the maximum; the Archives does not track your Nova balance.

items.name: Droid Tracker Pack
items.description: Unlock Rebirth Droid Alert, five levels of Droidex Notifications, Variant Watch and Tracker Workshop Paint.
details: Variant Watch: alerts for the selected variant or higher
Marking this pack owned fills in missing upgrades. Existing higher levels are preserved; reloading or rechecking does not add extra levels.

items.name: Scourge Surge
items.description: Sends Scourge energy across the Sandcrawler conveyor every 30 seconds for 5 minutes.
details: Each wave has a 10% chance to turn blueprints it passes into Scourge variants.
At least one Scourge conversion is guaranteed per wave.
A lobby conveyor boost, not a multiplier to the income of droids you already own.
